Terms

Terms of use

Altiora is free to use, with no account. By using it you agree to these terms. They are short, so please read them.

Last updated 14 November 2026

Free information, not advice

Altiora gives general information about university courses and their entry requirements, free of charge. It is not professional, careers or admissions advice, and it does not replace advice from your school, the university or a qualified adviser.

Always check with the university

Entry requirements change every year, and universities can change them at any time. Before you choose subjects or apply, always confirm the requirements on the university’s official course page.

How requirements are labelled

Each requirement in Altiora is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source where there is one. Some requirements are only partly verified or have not yet been checked; they are marked that way so you know to check them yourself.

No guarantees

We work to keep the information accurate, but we cannot guarantee that it is complete, correct or up to date. A result in Altiora, such as a “strong match”, is not a prediction or a promise of an offer or of admission. Only universities make admissions decisions.

Your information

What you enter in the app is saved only in your own browser. The privacy policy explains what the site does with information.

Who runs Altiora

Altiora is run by Adam Arab, in Dubai, UAE. Contact: support@usealtiora.com.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed.
